reproduce the failure. Rebind this dataset to gw-onprem-02 rather than spending the retry on a
known-bad gateway. The next scheduled failure would deactivate the currently enabled refresh
schedule (3 of 4 failures), risking a silent stale report. This is a human-gated change because
rebinding affects every dataset bound to the gateway and may have wider operational impact.
